purpose: AC-ANNOUNCE-1..5: enforce per-type actor rules for enum (system) chat announcements at INGEST TIME, strictly before deps.appendMessage, so a rejected announcement leaves no chat row, no setChatVersion bump, no unread increment, and no notification (AC-ANNOUNCE-1). Per-type rules: group_renamed/invite_lifecycle('invited'|'declined')/invite_cancelled require an admin/creator actor but are never roster-gated (AC-ANNOUNCE-2 — subject rendered as an unverified claim); member_admitted/invite_lifecycle('accepted') additionally roster-gate the subject once, at first ingest, with the outcome baked into whether a row is ever persisted — never re-evaluated on a later groupDataVersion bump (AC-ANNOUNCE-3, verified via an integrated-e2e non-retroactivity test); call_notice's displayed actor is always sender.pubkey (ChatMessage.senderPubkey), never the payload's self-reported initiator (AC-ANNOUNCE-4); group_renamed is admin-gated (AC-ANNOUNCE-5). Two Amendment fold-ins land in the same ingest gate: (a) F1 (S5 Stage-2 review) creator-gates the kind-9 poll_close CHAT ANNOUNCEMENT (sender.pubkey === stored Poll.creatorPubkey) and rewrites its persisted content to a recomputed tally from stored PollVote rows — never the closer's self-reported results/totalVoters; (b) F1/S3 (S3 Stage-2 review) gates the kind-9 leave_intent DEPARTURE ANNOUNCEMENT on structured.pubkey === sender.pubkey, mirroring leaveHandler.ts's kind-13 forced-removal rule. All admin/roster lookups fail closed (indeterminate provider/lookup rejects, never defaults to accept — VQ-S6-006).

public_api.name: createChatHandler
public_api.description: Unchanged signature. Internal handle() now runs parseStructured(content) + a per-type ingest gate BEFORE building the ChatMessage / calling deps.appendMessage. A rejected announcement returns early with zero side effects (no appendMessage, no resolvePendingSignalsForSlot, no setChatVersion, no incrementUnread/markAsRead).

public_api.name: ChatHandlerDeps
public_api.signature: interface ChatHandlerDeps { appendMessage; incrementUnread; markAsRead; setChatVersion; applyDeleteEditSignal; resolvePendingSignalsForSlot; isGroupAdmin: (groupId: string, pubkeyHex: string) => Promise<boolean>; isGroupMember: (groupId: string, pubkeyHex: string) => Promise<boolean>; getPoll: (groupId: string, pollId: string) => Promise<Poll | null>; loadVotes: (pollId: string) => Promise<PollVote[]> }
public_api.description: Four new fields. isGroupAdmin/isGroupMember back the admin- and roster-actor gates; both fail closed (reject on throw/indeterminate). getPoll/loadVotes are the SAME accessors already injected into PollHandlerDeps (registerHandlers.ts threads deps.getPoll/deps.loadVotes to both — no new top-level HandlerDeps fields for these two).

public_api.name: computeTally
public_api.signature: computeTally(options: PollOptionDef[], votes: PollVote[]): { results: PollResult[]; totalVoters: number }
public_api.description: Extracted from pollHandler.ts (module-private there previously) into a new shared pure utility app/src/lib/marmot/pollTally.ts, so chatHandler.ts's poll_close ingest-gate recompute and pollHandler.ts's handleClose recompute share one implementation (DRY — the two call sites must never independently drift). pollHandler.ts is refactored to import it; behavior is unchanged (verified against the existing pollHandler.test.ts suite).

public_api.name: isRegisteredGroupAdmin
public_api.description: New export on app/src/lib/messageEdits/api.ts, wrapping the ALREADY-REGISTERED GroupAdminsProvider singleton (groupAdminsFor + isAdminPubkey, both pre-existing module-private helpers) so chatHandler's admin-actor gate consults the exact same admin set as the announcement-immutability delete/edit gate — not a second, independently-instantiated lookup (VQ-S6-002). Inherits fail-closed semantics from groupAdminsFor (unregistered provider / non-group threadKey / throwing provider -> [] -> false).

Two categories of necessary expansion: (1) composition-root wiring — the 4 new ChatHandlerDeps fields (isGroupAdmin, isGroupMember, getPoll, loadVotes) must be threaded through registerHandlers.ts's HandlerDeps and MarmotContext.tsx's buildDispatcher(...) call, the only place live closures exist; messageEdits/api.ts gains isRegisteredGroupAdmin so the admin gate reuses the ALREADY-registered GroupAdminsProvider (VQ-S6-002) instead of re-instantiating one. (2) AC-ANNOUNCE-4's literal wording ('the structured payload's initiator field... is not rendered as the actor') cannot be satisfied by chatHandler.ts alone, since chatHandler.ts does not control rendering — architecture.md's own Scope section explicitly names this as call_notice's actor rule ('stop rendering initiator from the payload'), so the ChatBox.tsx one-line fix is required by the AC's substance, not incidental. pollTally.ts/pollHandler.ts avoid duplicating the recompute logic (DRY) rather than reimplementing it inline in chatHandler.ts.
